about: Written by scripts/acceptance-b.ts: Journey B over the real local MCP server with the official SDK client.

checks.claim: a real MCP server answered the SDK client over stdio
it exposes the play tools with schemas
the rules resource is served
three story chapters are listed
a game starts with day 1, Influence and the legal first moves
the map shows landmarks, villagers and coordinates
the state shows objectives, tonight's danger and the story hand
a villager shows who they trust, how much, and whether they can be reached (the social graph)
their private convictions are hidden until scouted
checks.detail: Ivo Thatcher, Storyteller. Their private convictions are hidden (scout them or speak to th

checks.claim: every action the agent took was in the server's list of legal actions
each cost charged equals the engine's own cost, and Influence fell by exactly that
days were ended one at a time and resolved
the rival's move was visible in the state and the agent answered it with a COUNTER
the run ended in victory with a debrief (headline, story, score, causal chains)
checks.detail: The village endures — 14 of 14 saved; score 820

checks.claim: the server reports the state and event hashes
the exported action log replays in the engine with nothing rejected
state hash identical to the server's
event hash identical to the server's (every event, in order)
the recorded browser trace produces the same final state
the replay names what it was recorded under (rules, save schema, generator, belief language, opening-state fingerprint), so an engine update cannot silently rewrite it
a stale revision is refused (STALE_REVISION) and the state is unchanged
a duplicate call (same idempotency key) does not act twice
an illegal action is refused with the reason and alternatives, and changes nothing
an action the player cannot pay for is refused with the reason, and changes nothing

checks.claim: an agent without control (coach mode) cannot act: READ_ONLY, state unchanged
another run id is not guessable and a path-shaped id is refused
a malformed action is refused by the schema before the game sees it
results are not available before the run ends
